description:
Problem: oracle_review_check.decide reads SHIP from the body of the oracle App's latest review over REST with no edit detection (_project/scripts/oracle_review_check.py:104-110,269-280); stand-ins are checked for edits, reviews are not. A live GraphQL query on 2026-10-26 showed the owner account, which every agent uses, has viewerCanUpdate and viewerCanDelete true on benchbox-oracle reviews. Editing a DO NOT SHIP body to the success header, or deleting a later DO NOT SHIP so an earlier SHIP for the same head becomes latest, turns oracle-gate green with no audit (the merge digest links only stand-ins). Related gaps: the gate also accepts legacy oracle-review-shadow headers and shadow-mode advisory bodies; the gate and sweep App tokens are minted with pull-requests: write though they only read; scripts/ruleset_drift_check.py does not check the oracle environment's deployment branch policy, so widening it would let another branch mint the App token undetected.

Outcome: a review counts only if it is unedited (GraphQL lastEditedAt null and includesCreatedEdit false) and its decision agrees with the commit status the verdict job posts with the App token for that exact head (report.py builds it with context plan status_context); commit statuses cannot be edited or deleted, so deleting a later review cannot revive an earlier SHIP. Disagreement never passes. Shadow headers are rejected. Gate and sweep tokens request pull-requests: read. The drift check verifies the oracle environment's branch policy.

Decision gates:
1. Before relying on it, confirm on live heads (read-only API) the verdict status context, its state mapping and that its creator is the oracle App; if a status cannot be tied to the App identity, stop and report.
2. Review and status disagree, or the status is missing for a review posted after this change: WAITING with a message naming the conflict; never PASS.
3. Stand-in checks stay exactly as strict as today.
4. Before removing shadow-header acceptance, list (read-only API) open develop PRs whose latest oracle review opens with '### oracle-review-shadow:'; if any exist, stop and report them; never rerun the oracle on them.
5. Prefer the smaller mechanism: if gate 1 shows the App-created verdict status alone carries the head's decision, decide from that status and stop reading decisions from review bodies instead of building edit detection; record the choice. Either way, an edited or deleted review never passes.

Item guardrails: no change to the ruleset, the App binding (integration 5201041) or the decision rule beyond rejecting tampered evidence; read errors still fail closed; review and thread pagination keep parity.

Common guardrails: work only in a linked worktree created by make worktree-create, then make agent-write-preflight; the primary clone is read-only. Never use git stash (refs/stash is shared across worktrees). Commit as Joe Harris <joeharris76@gmail.com>, staging explicit paths only; no git add -A, no --no-verify, no SKIP, no agent trailers. Durable text (commits, PR bodies, docs, code) carries no tracker ids, session labels or plan references. Maintained code has no explanatory comments or docstrings (make comment-policy-check). Before publishing run make docs-reference-inventory-check, make doc-contracts-guard and make pr-preflight, and self-review with the code review action, fixing every Critical and Required finding. Publish only with make pr-open: never gh pr create, a raw push-and-open, or a PR-body override line; if make pr-open refuses, stop and report the exact refusal instead of routing around it. Until oracle-omp-pin-single-source-20261026 merges, make pr-open may run only with PATH prefixed by the darwin-arm64 omp 18.12.1 build recorded in that item (SHA-256 fa41b27d434380e99b713e4f9ced0f73eb1fc0c409fdf23a57c119971d24bac5, from https://build.stencil.so/d/omp/20261017-231446-291e055/omp-darwin-arm64), verified with shasum immediately before use; never any other side-loaded omp. Close out only with oracle SHIP on the exact head, every oracle thread answered (reply naming the fixing SHA, then resolve) and make pr-arm; never raw gh pr merge or a ruleset or settings change, and never a stand-in, adjudication or backoff reset unless the owner names the PR and head (and the finding) in the current request after an Owner instruction comment. Never edit, delete, dismiss or minimise an oracle review, review comment or commit status, and never post a commit status by hand. Run /oracle-review only on a pending or absent head, or after a Dispute: reply with file:line counter-evidence; never to re-roll a decided head. Do not close, reopen, rerun or rebase other PRs. Until oracle-gateway-cloud-builder-access-20261025 merges, publish only from the owner's Mac. Rollback: if a change to the verdict or gate workflows or to the local review breaks its first live run after merge in a way that blocks other PRs, stop, run make trunk-revert PR=<n>, and report to the owner, who chooses between an absence stand-in and the broken-oracle-gate procedure. Never print tokens, keys, or the gateway URL or hostname; never spend model quota outside the review harness. Owner decisions are recorded in context and in the decisions file; a step that would contradict one stops and asks the owner.
